acceptanceCriteria: Profiling at >=10,000 receipts identifies which of these dominate; the dominant ones are reduced or bounded with a test.
Resumed/retry count is visible in the command result or the omission is recorded as a decision.
body: Found by lane V1-1560 (PR beamfall/corvint#1018, head c843d6aab, GitHub #1010) on 2026-10-17. Residual costs after resume: receipt and request-shard listings under the writer lock grow with file count; registering the change guard visits every store file; commitLease takes the writer lock only to report a preparation failure. The CLI does not expose the Resumed count, and the optional retry count/audit duration in the retryable result was NOT_PRODUCED.
title: Pool acquire costs still grow with store file count; Resumed count not shown
